addition.item: Initial stable release for Joomla! 5 and Joomla! 6 with full en-GB and pt-BR language packs.

Native DI/MVC component (com_pmsnippets) with ID-less SEF routing, FULLTEXT and raw code AJAX search, faceted filters, versioned code tabs, one-click copy, file download, useful votes, multilingual associations, and Schema.org SoftwareSourceCode JSON-LD.
Local zero-CDN matte syntax highlighter supporting 8 languages (PHP, Bash, JavaScript, SQL, htaccess, XML, JSON, CSS).
Interactive showcase module (mod_pmsnippets) with home, grid, and compact layouts.
Smart Search plugin (plg_finder_pmsnippets) indexing 6 taxonomies and Content shortcode plugin (plg_content_pmsnippets).
Configured native GitHub-hosted Joomla Update Server (updates.xml) and Changelog XML (changelog.xml).
